description: This file implements the TraceMedia class, which handles tracing and message processing for a networked tracing system within the WPEFramework. It includes methods for outputting trace information, handling incoming messages, and managing trace categories.

classes.name: TraceMedia
classes.description: A class responsible for managing trace output and message handling over a network, including formatting trace data and processing control commands.

methods.name: TraceMedia::TraceMedia
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TraceMedia object with a network node ID and opens the output channel.

methods.name: TraceMedia::Output
methods.description: Formats and sends a trace message with timestamp, file, class, and trace information.

methods.name: TraceMedia::HandleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming control messages, such as listing categories or toggling tracing.

methods.name: TraceMedia::Write
methods.description: Placeholder method for writing data frames; currently does nothing.

methods.name: TraceMedia::CopyText
methods.description: Copies a null-terminated string into a destination buffer with size limit, ensuring null termination.
